headline: Easy breeding chain: Suzaku
title: Easy Suzaku Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Want Suzaku in Palworld without hunting for one? Follow this easy three step breeding chain. Step one: breed Sparkit with Vanwyrm to get Chillet. Step two: breed that Chillet with Wumpo to get Felbat. Step three: breed Felbat with Wumpo, and the egg hatches into Suzaku! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Suzaku: Sparkit + Vanwyrm = Chillet, Chillet + Wumpo = Felbat, Felbat + Wumpo = Suzaku. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
